name: Ana Marcos-Gonzalez
abstract_title: PARALLELISM BETWEEN ULTRASOUND AND SOUND IN THE TRANSFORMATION OF CONSCIOUSNESS IN NEURODEGENERATIVE DISEASES: A KEY TO PREVENTION?
abstract: Ultrasound therapies for Neurological disorders are providing promising results, especially in Neurodegenerative cases such as Alzheimer’s Disease and Parkinson’s Disease, as well as in Headaches or Chronic Pain. Sound therapies, on the other hand, are also providing significant benefits in psychological disorders such as Anxiety, Trauma, and Depression. We present the first approach of our study on the parallelism between both techniques based on different levels of the sound scale. We specific
